brief.fear: That what he sees means something is wrong with him.
brief.contradiction: He reads people better than anyone yet cannot tell whom to trust.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: He knows what a person fears before they speak.

voice.diction: Concrete and short; notices what is unsaid.

source_notes.summary: Prologue cast for ADR 0033 (SD-05); the almshouse house itself is a plausible composite.
